title: The Supported Credit Limit of a Commercial Credit Account
content:
**Credit Department method — the limit a Commercial Credit Account's purchasing supports.**

> The supported limit is the monthly purchase base times the terms coverage, rounded to the nearest cent only on that final figure.

### Definitions

- **Monthly purchase base.** The invoice totals posted on the account in the last twelve whole months divided by twelve (12 months in the year).
- **Terms coverage.** The tier's net terms days plus thirty days, divided by thirty; the days added are 30.
- **Whole months.** Whole months between a date and today are the difference in calendar months, less one when today's day of the month is earlier than that date's day of the month, with no move of a month-end date to a shorter month's last day. The last twelve whole months are the invoices dated less than twelve whole months before today.
- **Combination.** Every amount a schedule in this rule adds is added to the monthly purchase base, and every percentage a schedule sets multiplies the supported limit, before the figure is rounded.

### Terms coverage by net terms

| Net terms days | Coverage |
|---|---|
| 10 | 40 divided by 30, one and one third |
| 30 | 2 |
| 45 | 2.5 |
| 60 | 3 |
| 90 | 4 |

### Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

Invoice totals of 246000.00 in the last twelve whole months on a Net 30 tier: monthly purchase base 20500.00; coverage 2; supported limit 41000.00.

On a Net 10 tier with invoice totals of 10000.00: monthly purchase base 833.33 and one third (unrounded), coverage one and one third, supported limit 1111.11.
